subject: Post-call: Reshaping POC roadmap & updated success criteria
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@shoploom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Hi Elena — great to meet today, thanks for walking through Shoploom's cart-abandonment and product-suggestion use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth:  

Summary of what we heard from Shoploom:
- Primary objective: improve add-to-cart conversion by surfacing personalized product suggestions in cart and at checkout.
- Secondary objective: reduce false positives in intent routing (reduce manual reviews).
- Data notes: 6 months of anonymized cart and session logs available in S3; PII lives in a separate store and will not be ingested.

Proposed POC scope (v1):
- Ingest 3 weeks of session+cart logs for training/eval (Karthik owner)
- Model endpoints for suggestion generation + reranking (Redwood hosted)
- Eval: suggestion relevance (precision@5) + latency p95 target initially <= 900ms (Monica owner for metrics)
- Success criteria: +6% add-to-cart lift in A/B sandbox OR precision@5 >= 0.45 with acceptable latency and no data leakage.

Attachments: I attached POC-Plan-v1.docx and a working SuccessCriteria spreadsheet (POC-SuccessCriteria-v2.xlsx).

Requests / next steps:
1) Can you confirm Shoploom is comfortable with the proposed hosts and that your security team will accept Redwood's standard SOC2 + VPC peering checklist? (If not, please flag which items.)
2) Confirm owners on your side for data export and validation (we expect one data engineer + one PM).
3) If the scope looks OK we'll schedule a 60-min kickoff next week to lock timelines (I propose Oct 6 for a kickoff, but flexible).

If you want to expand the scope during the trial we can rebaseline; best practice is to lock a minimal acceptance set and identify "stretch" use cases so we can measure incrementally.

Thanks — I'll hold the kickoff slot tentatively for Oct 6.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments referenced: POC-Plan-v1.docx, POC-SuccessCriteria-v2.xlsx

From: Elena Soto <elena@shoploom.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Ben — thanks for the crisp summary and the docs. This aligns closely with what our PM/analytics team expects. A few clarifications + changes from our side: 

1) Scope add: we'd like to include a lightweight "product-suggestion extraction" from customer messages (chat transcripts) as a stretch use case. If feasible, we want to see initial results in parallel with cart logs.
2) Success criteria tweak: in addition to precision@5, our legal team wants an explicit redaction check for transactional data (no financial identifiers surfaced). Can you include a validation step for redaction?
3) Timeline: we can commit one data engineer (Aisha) and our PM (Tom) for validation. Kickoff on Oct 6 works if we push the ingest window by one week — i.e., begin active model runs on Oct 20 to give us time to scrub/export sample data and complete your security checklist.

I've attached a short requirements doc (Shoploom-POC-Requirements.pdf) with a security note and a sample chat transcript (sanitized).

If you can send a rebaseline that folds in the chat-transcript extraction as a stretch use case and adds a redaction validation step, we can sign off and commit to the dates. Also point me to the SOC2 + VPC checklist link.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Product
Shoploom
---
Attachments referenced: Shoploom-POC-Requirements.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@shoploom.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed trial plan (next steps)

Elena — great, thanks for the clarity and the requirements doc. Confirming we can accommodate the requested changes with a rebaseline. Key updates below: 

Rebaseline summary (what changes):
- Core POC remains cart-suggestion + reranking.
- Stretch use case: product-suggestion extraction from chat transcripts run in parallel (evaluation as a separate axis).
- New acceptance step: automated redaction check for transaction/financial identifiers. We'll run a validation script against outputs and include results in the evaluation dashboard.

Updated owners and actions:
- Redwood (Ben): overall trial lead, will deliver updated SuccessCriteria spreadsheet and revised M-A-P.
- Redwood (Karthik): data ingestion pipeline and sample validation scripts (deadline Oct 15).
- Redwood (Monica): evaluation dashboard + metric tracking (initial dashboard by Oct 22).
- Shoploom (Aisha): data export + sample verification (deliver by Oct 13).
- Shoploom (Tom): PM signoff on acceptance criteria and go/no-go decisions.

Updated timeline (high level):
- Oct 6: Kickoff (60m) — confirm network/connectivity checks and data export plan.
- Oct 13: Shoploom provides final sanitized export samples.
- Oct 15: Redwood completes ingestion pipeline and runs first pass.
- Oct 20: First model runs + metrics collection window opens (2 weeks of evaluation window).
- Nov 3: Initial evaluation readout and go/no-go decision.

Success criteria (revised):
- Primary: precision@5 >= 0.45 OR measured +6% add-to-cart lift in sandbox (whichever is easier to instrument).
- Latency: response p95 <= 850ms (we'll target improvements during the trial).
- Safety: automated redaction checks show 0 instances of unredacted financial identifiers in test outputs.

I'll attach the updated POC-SuccessCriteria-v2.xlsx after this note and link the SOC2/VPC checklist here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-PoC-1147 (permissions set to view for your team). Also CC'ing our security contact internally if you need a direct thread.

Please confirm you and your team sign off on the new dates/owners and we'll calendar the kickoff. If anyone on your side needs earlier access to the ingestion templates, reply and I'll share them.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Shoploom rebaseline — immediate next actions

Team — internal summary / action items after confirming rebaseline with Shoploom (capture for our tracker):

1) Karthik: build ingestion templates and sample-validation scripts. Deliverables: S3 ingest manifest + redaction validator. Due Oct 15.
2) Monica: spin up evaluation dashboard (precision@k, latency p95, redaction failure counts). Wire dashboard to our trial tracing hooks. Initial dashboard by Oct 22.
3) Ben: send updated SuccessCriteria spreadsheet + mutual-action-plan (M-A-P) to Elena and Shoploom execs; confirm kickoff calendar invite (I will send both items today).
4) Coordinate security contact handoff if Shoploom requests SOC2 evidence or VPC peering.

Risks / notes:
- Stretch chat-transcript extraction might require additional labeling to reach parity; mark as "stretch" and measure separately.
- If redaction validator flags issues we may need a short remediation spike; call this out as potential cost/time variance in the M-A-P.

I'll create the HubSpot tasks and attach the updated spreadsheets to the deal record (DL-2026-1147).

Ben

Redwood Inference
